headline: NYY @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYY 4.62 at DET 4.41, with a projected total of 9.03. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward DET: NYY moved +0.29 runs while DET moved +0.55, changing the projected margin by -0.25 runs. The projected total climbed +0.84, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -6.1%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Gerrit Cole has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Paul Goldschmidt, Dillon Dingler, Ben Rice, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jahmai Jones, Matt Vierling because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
